what: sensitivity of the v2 scope study to the extracted stray capacitance at the divider node N (0.68 +- 0.13 pF with pour, top of the error bar 0.81 pF) and N-to-N 0.05 fF
how: python3 -I run.py --set Cn_par=<F> --set Cx=5e-17 <section> for ac bw mc static xtalk stab, one process each, in the PCB image (ngspice 45.2); baseline = the golden (ported code reproduces it exactly)

cases.baseline: Cn_par 3.5 pF (the study's assumed pad/trace stray at N; the macro adds about 0.5 pF), Cx 0
cases.A_N_stray_plus_0p81pF: Cn_par 3.5 + 0.81 = 4.31 pF, Cx (N to N) 0.05 fF; the extraction ADDED to the assumption
cases.B_N_stray_replaced_by_0p81pF: Cn_par 0.81 pF, Cx 0.05 fF; the extraction REPLACING the assumption

note: mc draws its own stray (uniform 2..6 pF at N) whatever Cn_par is, so its figures do not move. The xtalk sweeps (Cx_N_to_N, combined budget) set Cx themselves, so the 0.05 fF N-N value acts only on shared_rail_ref_only; the N stray moves the sweeps through Cn_par.
